schema: members: name -> file, status nonsegmented (ccv1 -O) and segmented (sccv1 -O), note
compiler: v1 nearest (02/11/83); v1 with OLD_D2N, D2L, D2F or D2W (each alone) is not nearer (measured 2026-11-18)

util.o.note: error() writes sizeof("\r\nFatal system error: ") bytes: the NUL too.

key.o.note: kycopy needs the casts (int *) in wdcopy (the reload of the parameters).

node.o.note: segmented: a scratch register (r2 against r6) in btremove.

buf.o.note: segmented: scratch registers in bfread/bfwrite (the node trailer bytes).

supp.o.note: nonsegmented: freefile, close(fp->f_audfd): the original keeps the parameter fp in r2 (temp r6), v1 takes r3.

read.o.note: isread: the original takes r3 for openp (r2 holds lock), v1 r2.

audit.o.note: isaudit AUDSTOP, close(filep->f_audfd): the original reloads filep (temp r3), v1 reuses r3 (temp r6).

open.o.note: nonsegmented: scratch register choices in isopen (ldint of dictp), isflush, isexit.

btree.o.note: btsearch: scratch register after the dup test; btdelitem: the original popt keeps the loop test at the head, v1 popt inverts it.

item.o.note: itcompare FLOATTYPE: the original compares two floats in single precision register against register (fld F1; 8E00,4120), v1 converts f2 from memory (4021) and compares double; itpress: a register (r4/r2) and the loop of the leading compression (not inverted in the original).

build.o.note: isaddindex: the loop and its error block laid out differently by popt; isbuild: register use in the dictionary init.
